Students have a new competition, and the prize is really big.

The national innovation agency and a financial education project announce a new university competition. Participants can present financial technology ideas and solve real problems.

The winning team travels to a big technology conference, and the prize fund includes a grant of twenty thousand lari. Students aged seventeen and older can take part.

Each team needs two to four students and one mentor. Registration runs until the start of October, so time is short.

If you like thinking about money, do not miss this chance.
